neutralBodyTopBasis: Inspected compact dark-hair crown at neutral source y77; neither spear butt nor shoulder armor lies above crown; scale uses bootsole ground421 rather than spearpoint433.
manualRootReviewBasis: All18 actual near-boot source regions and both-boot contact rectangles were inspected on the witness guide. The world root follows shoe ground, with spearpoint10–15sourcepixels below ground retained in padding, never bbox or weapon recentering.

rootReviewPolicy: Review source and native strip. Set neutralTopY to the actual crown/body top (exclude props), neutralBodyTopConfirmed=true and neutralBodyTopBasis. For every frame set rootX/rootY from both boots, bootPairSupportWitness=[left,top,right,bottom] covering both boot support bands, and manualRootBasis (or a shared manualRootReviewBasis). Run --render after edits, then explicit confirm with exact-hash visual assessment.
